_comment: Water bottle + any black dye. Vanilla Ingredient is item-only (test() is literally input.is(values)),
so matching the water INSIDE the bottle needs a loader ingredient -- Fabric's fabric:components here,
NeoForge's neoforge:components in its own copy of this file. Same recipe, two dialects.
Kept as an ordinary shapeless recipe so JEI and EMI show it with no plugin from us.
c:dyes/black holds only black dye, so squid ink still routes through the dye step first.
